notes: Item 19 discloses Net Sales data for All Franchise Stores and three regional subgroups (West, Central, East) across three reporting periods (2025, 2024, 2023). The 2025 'All Franchise Stores' percentage exceeding average is listed as 10.5% in the document, which appears anomalous given 384/947 = ~40.5%; this likely reflects an OCR or typographical error in the source document — value captured as-is. Reporting periods are trailing 52 weeks ending September 24, 2025; September 23, 2024; and September 25, 2023 respectively, treated as annual. All cohorts are all_franchised scoped to domestic stores open the full trailing 52-week period. Regional cohorts tagged as 'other' with cohort_raw capturing the region label.
